IPMR Reports

Generate Integrated Program Management Report (IPMR) documents for programme oversight.

ipmr_reports

IPMR/CPR EVM Report Export Router.

This module provides the API endpoints for generating and exporting statutory Earned Value Management (EVM) reports compliant with the Integrated Program Management Report (IPMR) / Cost Performance Report (CPR) Formats 1 through 5.

Endpoints

All endpoints are JWT-authenticated and require the caller to have sufficient clearance to access the programme data.

  • GET /ipmr/format1: Emits Format 1 WBS spreadsheet for the selected reporting month. Returns BCWS (PV), BCWP (EV), and ACWP (AC) data for each WBS element with derived variances and indices.

  • GET /ipmr/format5: Emits variance narrative report pre-populated with active blocker logs. Auto-extracts tasks exceeding predefined variance thresholds and generates Problem/Cause, Impact, and Corrective Action Plan narratives.

Export Formats

Reports can be exported in two formats:

  • XLSX (default): OpenPyXL-formatted spreadsheet with defence table styling, locked header bands, and formula integrity.

  • PDF: Hardened PDF export with embedded vector styles for executive submission.

Usage

# Generate Format 1 report as Excel GET /api/v1/reports/evm/ipmr/format1?project_id={uuid}&reporting_period=2026-10&status_date=2026-10-24

# Generate Format 5 report as PDF GET /api/v1/reports/evm/ipmr/format5?project_id={uuid}&reporting_period=2026-10&status_date=2026-10-24&export_format=pdf

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: Generate and export IPMR Format 1 WBS time-phased matrix report.

  • View: Generate and export IPMR Format 5 Variance Analysis Narrative report.
